name: Modanganj

queries.query: Modanganj Bihar official cadastral land records map parcel GIS
queries.result: First-party discovery identified Bihar's official BhuNaksha cadastral viewer, Bihar Land Records reports, the Directorate of Land Records & Survey, and BiharBhumi. The official report explicitly lists Jehanabad / Modanganj; the public viewer exposed a live administrative hierarchy and map service routes.

queries.query: मोडनगंज बिहार आधिकारिक भू-नक्शा भूमि अभिलेख पार्सल
queries.result: Hindi-language discovery reached the official BiharBhumi and Bihar BhuNaksha services. The official land-record report identifies Jehanabad district and Modanganj circle; the viewer's returned village labels and service responses were partly Hindi/English mixed. No public vector geometry response was obtained.

officialSourceAssessment.localCustodian: Jehanabad district land administration / Modanganj circle, Government of Bihar, evidenced by the official Bihar land-record reports.
officialSourceAssessment.stateService: BhuNaksha Bihar, Directorate of Land Records & Survey, Government of Bihar, is the public cadastral map service.
officialSourceAssessment.registryEvidence: The official CircleWiseReport lists Jehanabad Modanganj, and the official public BhuNaksha hierarchy resolves Bihar -> Jehanabad -> Modanganj. This establishes local registry/service context, not citywide geometry coverage.

requestOutcomes: TLS-verified GET retrieved the official BhuNaksha landing page and current indexmain viewer HTML, config.js, and index.js. TLS-verified POST requests to the live Levels/ListsAfterLevel endpoint returned Bihar's hierarchy, including Jehanabad code 33 and Modanganj code 05. The viewer JavaScript exposed MapInfo/getVVVVExtentGeoref, MapInfo/getPlotAtXY, MapInfo/getPlotByPlotNo, ScalarDatahandler, and WMS routes. No login, credentials, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe field request, or TLS exception was used. No full parcel polygon was returned by the bounded anonymous requests, so no sample GeoJSON is retained.
